question: The value of sin 73° + cos 137° is
solution:
**Given:**

sin 73° + cos 137°

**Formula used:**

sin 73° = sin(60° + 13°) = sin 60°cos 13° + cos 60°sin 13°

cos 137°= - cos(43°)

**Calculations:**

 sin 73° + cos 137° 

= sin(60° + 13°) + {- cos(43°)}

= sin 60°cos 13° + cos 60°sin 13° - cos(30° + 13°)

= (√3)/(2)cos 13° + (1)/(2)sin 13° - cos 30°cos 13° + sin 30°sin 13°

= (√3)/(2)cos 13° + (1)/(2)sin 13° - (√3)/(2)cos 13° + (1)/(2)sin 13°

= (1)/(2)sin 13° + (1)/(2)sin 13°

= sin 13°

**therefore The Required simplified value is sin 13°.**
